title: APIs and JSON: data across a boundary
description: Practice JSON serialization, decoding, runtime schema validation and public response shaping with a small Zod 4 API contract.
objectives: Distinguish a JavaScript object from serialized JSON
Identify values that JSON cannot represent directly
Validate unknown data with a runtime schema
Return an explicit public representation without leaking private fields
rubric: I demonstrated parsing valid and invalid JSON syntax.
I rejected wrong price types and unexpected fields using Zod.
I completed the lab and checked that private fields stay out of responses.
